notes:
Lead: VP Product (Maya Chen). Mid-market product analytics platform; heavy in-app help + guided tours. Initial ask: quick Hosted API demo to prototype conversational support, then evaluate Dedicated for sustained throughput and data isolation. Demo on 2026-03-03 — product team liked streaming responses and tool-calling examples. POC brief: prove latency SLOs (p95 <= 300ms) for chat at ~250 concurrent sessions and embedding/rerank throughput for search index updates.

Cost workshop (2026-03-10): ran with SE (Diego) and Optimize SME. Actions: run batching experiment (dynamic batching with 40-100ms hold), enable prefix/KV caching for session reprise, test 4-bit quantized 13B + 7B fallback combo. Diego suggested model routing policy: prefer quant-13b for user-facing chat, fall back to quant-7b for background summarization and low-cost reranks. We estimated token-unit economics: hosted_api baseline cost ~= $0.018/token-equivalent per 1M tokens; with batching/caching can reduce 30-45% on chat-heavy traffic.

POC plan agreed: 2-week Hosted POC capturing real traffic (prod-sampled) + Optimize config applied. Measure: p50/p95 latency, tokens-per-session, cache hit rate, cost-per-1000-queries. If metrics hit targets we pivot to Dedicated sizing (reserved GPU pool) and ask for TCO quote including burst capacity.

Security: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, audit logs pushed to SIEM, KMS integration for secrets, EU data residency for EU customers. Legal open issues: DPA addendum on subprocessing and retention windows. Procurement needs estimated 12-month committed ARR to justify Dedicated.

Quotes / customer comments: "We need predictable tail latency before committing to dedicated capacity." — Maya. "If we can get 35% unit-cost saving with caching and quantization it's a go." — Eng manager.

Stubs/Links referenced in notes: Fireflies transcript ff_20260303_aukland_demo_1420, pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ (drive link), support ticket INF-8421 for initial infra questions.
